dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped structures consist of high-intensity light perimeters surrounding lower-intensity dark centers. The most prominent dorsal structures exhibit sharp, non-linear edge boundaries with high-contrast gradients between the light ring and the dark surrounding field.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of asymmetrical, solid high-intensity pixel clusters is present in the lower-lateral region. These features show core pixel saturation without internal gradient transitions and are spatially distributed in a semi-ordered, dense cluster pattern.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three primary dorsal-lateral macro-annuli form a scalene triangle. An additional geometric relationship is formed by a series of four high-intensity blobs in the anterior region that align along a curved linear path.
